Primary field: '2014 larger-share economic sector record'
uncertain: The 2014 percentage values for Agriculture and Industry are not printed as numeric labels; comparison relies on relative vertical position of the markers at the 2014 x-tick.
Axis scales are unlabeled with numbers, so absolute percentages at 2014 cannot be read directly; only relative height (blue marker above red marker at 2014) is observable.

It is ambiguous which color/line corresponds to which axis label because the left axis is blue ('Agriculture (%)') but the red dashed line is the lower series, while the right axis is red ('Industry (%)') yet the blue solid line is the higher series at 2014; the color-to-axis binding is inconsistent with the line colors.
